text: I see. ok the other question i have is, based on the @GUIDING_LIGHT.md and the uv numbers im looking at here, maybe im wrong but it looks like a ton of repetition that could be reduced down because i get to 255 and then it says ...and 93 more but i think there are dupes in this set im pretty sure or they are all so similar it just looks like it
resolution: User's analysis question (are the UV islands dupes that could be reduced, per GUIDING_LIGHT) was confirmed and acted on: yes — the unwrap packed one island per face with zero dedup, which is the 'store the product not the factors' anti-pattern. Decision: build a dedup/instanced unwrap. Implemented under req_1255 (commit 44c581ef7) — congruent faces now share one atlas island. This entry captured the diagnosis + the go-decision; the build + tests live in req_1255.
